top_signals.title: Uganda Pushes First Oil to Mid-2027 as Iran War Holds Up Equipment
top_signals.summary: Uganda’s dream to achieve its first commercial oil production and crude exports has been delayed yet again, extending the country’s wait to more than two decades since commercial oil reserves were first discovered in the country in 2006. Officials from the Uganda National Oil Company (UNOC) and the Petroleum Authority of Uganda (PAU) have announced that Uganda’s first oil production and exports have now been pushed back to before the end of June 2027, blaming the delay on international supply chain bottlenecks and disruptions…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Eurasian Resources Group to split its Kazakh and African assets
top_signals.summary: Deal will free up more highly prized African copper and cobalt operations from Kazakh state control

top_signals.title: Brandon Copeland: Tale of Two Cities in College Sports
top_signals.summary: Tennessee basketball players and their athletic department drafted a proposed term sheet that includes a salary cap, a spending floor and guaranteed pay—the first such collective bargaining framework in college sports. Brandon Copeland, former NFL linebacker and cofounder of athletes.org, who advised the negotiations, talks about what the players agreed to and whether the cap or the floor mattered more to them. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: US and Russia to oppose talks on limiting autonomous weapons
top_signals.summary: Major arms producers the U.S. and Russia look set to oppose a push at a global meeting to launch negotiations on legally binding rules for autonomous weapons.

top_signals.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
top_signals.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Measles' Comeback Could Be Just the Start
top_signals.summary: The US has lost its long-standing measles eradication status. And this may be just the first public health victory to unravel under Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s watch, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Lisa Jarvis says. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Ending Alzheimer's with David Cameron
top_signals.summary: Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom David Cameron sits down with Bloomberg's David Merritt to talk about his podcast “Ending Alzheimer’s”, his personal journey and the increasingly bright future of Alzheimer’s treatment. He speaks with David Merritt, head of media editorial at Bloomberg, at a Bloomberg.com subscriber event in London. (Source: Bloomberg)
